description: IEEE journal graphics: 88.9mm (3.5 in) one-column width, 9-10pt consistent type, vector PS/EPS/PDF preferred, >300 dpi raster.
requirements_notes: One column width: 3.5 inches, 88.9 millimeters, or 21 picas. Two columns width: 7.16 inches, 182 millimeters, or 43 picas.
IEEE standards for non-vector graphics for color and grayscale images are >300dpi. IEEE standards for black and white line art are >600dpi.
IEEE accepts PS, EPS, PDF, PNG, or TIFF formats for graphics submission.
Acceptable vector file formats include PS, EPS, and PDF.

Select fonts from the recommended list: Helvetica, Times New Roman, Arial, Cambria, Symbol. Typefaces and type sizes should be consistent in all your graphics and tables. Type should appear approximately 9-10 point when viewed at full size.
Either convert all text to outlines or embed the fonts (EPS/PS/PDF).

colors.note: IEEE does not mandate a colour palette; Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe set used as default
